description: Static per-vehicle spacing values for microscopic traffic modeling. Longitudinal values are user-assumed. Lateral values are taken from the minimum lateral distance of vehicles when standing (0 km/h), as reported in Table 1 of Mishra et al. (2017), 'Novel Area Occupancy-Based Method for Passenger Car Unit Estimation on Multilane Urban Roads Under Heterogeneous Traffic Scenario', TRR No. 2615.
